name: print-social-creative-illustrator-portfolio-poster-orange-seal-badge
title: 'Creative — Illustrator' portfolio poster with an orange field, a flat character and a circular seal badge
whatItIs: An orange-bordered poster with bold black-and-outline 'Creative — Illustrator' title, a small circular scalloped seal badge, three service headings (Illustration, Animation, Motion Design) with short descriptions, a flat-illustrated character in a striped skirt and rollerblades, and squiggly line doodles.
whatItMeans: Friendly and characterful; a whimsical illustrated figure makes a personal portfolio poster memorable and distinctly the artist's own style.
techniques: Mix solid and outline type for a two-tone headline.
Use a scalloped seal badge for a certificate-like credibility touch.
Add a distinctive character illustration as a personal signature.

vocabulary.definition: A badge shape with a wavy, stamp-like edge.
A recurring illustrated figure representing an artist's style.
